scope.evidence: The diff contains only what the task asks: the enum, exception, action, its test, and the two required docs plus the mandated CHANGELOG entry (CHANGELOG.md:11). No HTTP/Livewire, no authorization layer, no unrelated refactors or extra features.

issues.explanation: The test named 'skips tickets already called elsewhere' calls $first->call($user) before invoking the action, so the candidate query never returns the called ticket and the lock-and-recheck skip branch is not actually exercised.
The fairness test has only one waiting normal ticket, so the requirement detail that the oldest normal is called is not asserted when several normals wait.
Maintaining $skippedIds and passing it to whereNotIn is redundant: a ticket that failed the re-check is no longer 'waiting', so the status filter of the next candidate query already excludes it.
The public __invoke has inline comments but no PHPDoc block, while the conventions ask for PHPDoc on public methods that are touched.
The TODO still says the test must be linked 'once implemented' even though the paragraph above now describes the implementation as done and names tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php.

review.summary: The change implements App\Actions\CallNextTicket with the CallMode enum, the dedicated NoWaitingTicketsException, deterministic priority/age/id ordering, the three-call fairness rule, and queue-plus-ticket locking, together with the required docs, a CHANGELOG entry and a broad Pest suite. All task requirements and the contract are met and the logic reads correctly; the main gaps are an untested lock-and-recheck skip branch and a handful of small simplicity/doc nits, so this is approvable with minor follow-ups.
